name: @projexlight/sdk-campaign
summary: Marketing campaign + journey orchestration for ProjexCloud: define a campaign with named segments + a multi-step journey (each step is an action — send email, post to Slack, wait, branch, score). Journeys run per-contact, respect consent + quiet-hours, and audit every step. The marketing-automation analog to sdk-workflow's general-purpose engine.

endpoints.description: Add a segment (named contact set with definition).
Start a run of a journey for the segment's members.

events.name: campaign.journey.published.v1
events.description: Journey definition published; carries step graph hash.

events.name: campaign.journey_run.started.v1
events.description: Run started for a (journey, contact) pair.

events.name: campaign.journey_run.step.v1
events.description: Per-step audit row for a run.

models.description: Campaign envelope row: name, owner, channel mix, budget.
Named contact set: definition (sql or rule), refreshed_at, member_count.
Journey definition: steps json, graph hash, published_at.
Per-(journey, contact) run: state, current_step, scheduled_next_step_at.

hooks.name: createCampaign
hooks.description: Service entry for a new campaign envelope.

hooks.name: publishJourney
hooks.description: Compile + publish a journey definition (steps + branches).

hooks.name: startJourneyRun
hooks.description: Start runs for the journey's segment members (one run per contact).

hooks.name: haltJourney
hooks.description: Kill switch — halts every in-flight run for a journey.

hooks.name: startJourneyExecutor
hooks.description: Background worker that advances pending journey steps.

scenarios.title: Create the 'EU Q3 Nurture' campaign + first segment
scenarios.when_to_use: Marketing manager kicks off a new nurture program; create the envelope + a segment for 'EU leads in Pro tier'.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Campaign + segment rows; member count returned. Segments refresh on the configured cadence.

scenarios.title: Publish a 5-step nurture journey
scenarios.when_to_use: Define the journey graph: email → wait 3d → branch (opened? → demo invite : retry email).
scenarios.expected_outcome: Journey published with graph hash. .journey.published.v1 emitted. Start runs explicitly via startJourneyRun.

scenarios.title: Lead score crosses threshold → auto-enroll in nurture
scenarios.when_to_use: Reactive on lead_scoring.score.changed.v1 — when a lead crosses MQL threshold, auto-enroll in the EU Q3 Nurture journey.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Run started for the contact; emits .journey_run.started.v1. Journey executor advances steps per cadence.

scenarios.title: Reactive: consent opt-out halts in-flight runs
scenarios.when_to_use: consent.receipt.revoked.v1 fires with marketing=false; immediately halt any in-flight journey runs for that contact (TCPA / GDPR Art-7 compliance).
scenarios.expected_outcome: Active runs halted within seconds; emits .journey_run.completed.v1 with reason='consent-revoked'. No further messages sent.

scenarios.title: Kill switch — halt a misconfigured journey
scenarios.when_to_use: Marketing ops realizes journey is sending the wrong email; halt the journey instantly + audit who pulled the switch.
scenarios.expected_outcome: All in-flight runs halted; emits .journey_run.completed.v1 with halt reason. Future enrolls in the journey refuse with error.

compliance_posture.notes: Journey executor checks sdk-consent before every outbound send. Consent revocation halts runs within sec. Every step audited so a regulator can replay 'why was this email sent to this person at this time'.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per active run (per-step billed via sdk-notification)
